description: This PHP file defines the ModuleController class within the SuiteCRM API v8 namespace. It implements various REST API endpoints for managing modules, including retrieving metadata, CRUD operations on module records, relationship management, and localization. The class interacts with SuiteCRM beans, view definitions, and configuration, handling JSON API requests and responses.

classes.name: ModuleController
classes.description: A controller class that provides REST API endpoints for module operations in SuiteCRM, supporting CRUD, relationship management, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: getModulesMetaList
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules with their API links.

methods.name: getModulesMetaMenuModules
methods.description: Provides metadata about module menu structure and access.

methods.name: getModulesMetaMenuFilters
methods.description: Returns metadata related to module filters and submodule visibility.

methods.name: getModulesMetaViewed
methods.description: Retrieves recently viewed modules and items for the current user.

methods.name: getModulesMetaFavorites
methods.description: Returns the current user's favorite modules and items.

methods.name: getModuleRecords
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of records for a specific module.

methods.name: createModuleRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record in the specified module.

methods.name: getModuleRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a specific module record by ID.

methods.name: updateModuleRecord
methods.description: Updates an existing module record identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteModuleRecord
methods.description: Deletes (marks as deleted) a module record by ID.

methods.name: getModuleMetaLanguage
methods.description: Fetches language strings for a specific module.

methods.name: getApplicationMetaLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves available languages for the application.

methods.name: getModuleMetaAttributes
methods.description: Returns the attribute metadata (field definitions) of a module.

methods.name: getModuleMetaFields
methods.description: Alias for getModuleMetaAttributes.

methods.name: getModuleMetaMenu
methods.description: Provides menu metadata for a module.

methods.name: getModuleRecordsViewed
methods.description: Returns recently viewed records for a module.

methods.name: getModuleFavorites
methods.description: Retrieves user's favorites for a module.

methods.name: getModuleMetaLayout
methods.description: Fetches layout/view definition metadata for a module and view.

methods.name: getModuleRelationship
methods.description: Fetches relationship data for a module record.

methods.name: createModuleRelationship
methods.description: Creates a relationship link between records.

methods.name: updateModuleRelationship
methods.description: Updates relationship links for a record.

methods.name: deleteModuleRelationship
methods.description: Removes a relationship link from a record.
